hardware.candidate_role: USB/display signer bring-up with current host-core protocol scaffold

procedure: Exported ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell invocation used for build, flash, and smoke commands.
Verified idf.py resolved to /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/tools/idf.py and esptool.py resolved to /Users/vincenzo/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.9_env/bin/esptool.py.
Verified make detect-board saw /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 as an ESP32-S3 native USB-Serial/JTAG device.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-flash from NostrSeal/esp32.
Verified esptool wrote bootloader, app, and partition-table images and reported Hash of data verified for each image.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-smoke-capabilities from NostrSeal/esp32 after flashing.
expected_result: The current firmware builds, flashes cleanly, answers capability and development public-key requests, refuses sign_event with signing_disabled, and rejects invalid metadata plus shared invalid signing-request vectors with deterministic unsupported_request error frames.
observed_result: ESP-IDF v5.5.4 built app version 61b51df with binary size 0x7e6a0 and 0x81960 bytes free in the app partition. esptool detected ESP32-S3 QFN56 revision v0.2 with native USB-Serial/JTAG and MAC ec:da:3b:95:32:98, wrote bootloader, app, and partition-table images, and verified hashes. The smoke passed with 33 verified exchanges: 6 valid response frames and 27 expected rejection frames. sign_event remained signing_disabled.
limitations: Protocol smoke only; no trusted display, GPIO, camera, storage, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, or real signing acceptance was tested.
The USB serial scaffold still exposes development capability and public-key responses only.
get_public_key uses the deterministic development fixture key, not production key custody.
sign_event is expected to remain disabled until parser limits, trusted display review, physical approval, provisioning, storage, signed-output verification, and firmware hardening gates are complete.
